definition: ANZSCO code(s) the course's typical occupation maps to. This is the key that links a course to skilled-migration lists. Source: govt, not uni site.
data_notes: Open list of 6-digit ANZSCO codes; a course can map to several; [] if none.

definition: Which skilled list the linked occupation sits on; determines which PR/visa pathways apply. Source: Dept of Home Affairs.
data_notes: One fixed value; sourced from Dept of Home Affairs; refresh when lists change.

definition: Convenience flag = true if the occupation is on any current skilled list (the 'is it on SOL' question).
data_notes: Boolean; convenience flag derived from skilled_occupation_list_status.

definition: Points contributed by the Australian Study Requirement for this qualification level (the 'PR points by study level' need).
data_notes: Whole number of points from the official points test.

definition: Extra PR points (currently +5) for studying at a regional campus.
data_notes: Whole number; currently +5 for regional study.

definition: Extra PR points for a STEM Master's/Doctorate. Derived from discipline_type + course_level.
data_notes: Whole number; derived from discipline_type + course_level.

data_source: Government / Immigration (See Professional Year in Australia)
definition: Whether a Professional Year program (ACS/CPA/EA) is available for +5 points.
data_notes: This is only for Bachelors', Masters' or Higher degrees

possible_values: e.g. ACS, Engineers Australia, CPA Australia, VETASSESS
definition: Assessing body for the linked occupation (ACS, Engineers Australia, CPA, VETASSESS, etc.).
data_notes: Open list; assessing body for the linked occupation.

definition: Duration of the Temporary Graduate (Subclass 485) visa for this level/location.
data_notes: Years (decimal ok); varies by level and regional status.

definition: Whether the campus is in a designated regional area (postcode-based). Directly answers 'regional or not'.
data_notes: Boolean; from campus postcode vs the regional-area list.

definition: Rough 190/491 state-nomination demand for the linked occupation.
data_notes: One indicative value for 190/491 demand by state.

definition: Australian Qualifications Framework level (1-10). Enables level-based matching and PR-points logic.
National Occupational Classification code(s) the course maps to. Links to Express Entry / PNP.
data_notes: Open list of 5-digit NOC 2021 codes; [] if none.

definition: Length of the Post-Graduation Work Permit. Extends the existing pgwp_alignment (yes/no) field.
data_notes: Whole number of months; extends existing pgwp_alignment (Yes/No).

definition: Whether the program meets the 2024+ field-of-study eligibility rules for PGWP.

possible_values: STEM / Healthcare / Trades / Transport / Agriculture / French / None
definition: Category-based Express Entry draw relevance for the linked occupation.
data_notes: One value from the category-based draw list.

possible_values: e.g. ON, BC, AB, SK (2-letter province codes)
definition: Provinces where the linked occupation is in demand under a PNP stream.
Whether a co-op/placement is part of the course (affects work rights and outcomes).
Guaranteed Investment Certificate amount required for the study permit (budget planning).
Whether French ability meaningfully boosts the CRS score for this pathway.
Eligibility for the post-study Graduate visa.
Graduate route duration (2 years; 3 for PhD).
SOC 2020 occupation code for the Skilled Worker visa pathway.
Going-rate / salary threshold for sponsored work in the linked occupation.
Whether the occupation is on the Immigration Salary List (former Shortage Occupation List).
Whether the institution holds a Student sponsor licence (can issue CAS).
Eligibility for the NZ Post Study Work Visa.
Duration of the NZ post-study work visa for this level.

possible_values: Tier 1 - Straight to Residence / Tier 2 - Work to Residence / Not listed
definition: Whether the linked occupation is on the NZ Green List (residence pathway).
data_notes: One value; from Immigration NZ Green List.

definition: The role name if the occupation is on the Green List.
data_notes: Free text; role name if on the Green List, else null.

definition: Contribution to Skilled Migrant Category points.
Whether the campus is outside Auckland (regional study incentives).
data_notes: Boolean; true if campus is outside Auckland.

definition: NZ Qualifications Framework level (1-10) as a number for matching. Schema stores NZQCF only as an identifier string.
data_notes: Whole number 1-10; numeric form of the NZQCF identifier.

definition: Whether the program's CIP code is on the DHS STEM Designated Degree Program List (unlocks 24-month OPT extension). Derived from CIP.
data_notes: Boolean; derived from whether the CIP code is on the DHS STEM list.

definition: Total OPT available: 12 months, plus 24 where STEM-eligible.
data_notes: Whole number; 12 standard, 36 with STEM extension.

definition: Whether the program offers Day-1 CPT (flag; often scrutinised by USCIS).
data_notes: Boolean; flag, often scrutinised by USCIS.

definition: Whether the institution is a cap-exempt H-1B employer (universities / nonprofits).

possible_values: EB-1 / EB-2 / EB-2 NIW / EB-3 / None
definition: Typical employment-based green card route for graduates of this field.
Estimated annual living cost for the campus city. Core input to the budget simulation.
data_notes: Number amount + ISO currency; per campus city.

definition: Tuition + living + insurance estimate for the whole course.
data_notes: Number amount + ISO currency; tuition + living + insurance for whole course.

definition: City cost-of-living index, comparable across locations.
data_notes: Decimal index; fix a base (e.g. NYC = 100) for comparability.

definition: Funds the student must show for the visa (GIC / blocked account / bank balance).
data_notes: Number amount + ISO currency; funds shown for the visa.

definition: Whether installment / payment-plan options are offered.
Estimated years to recoup total cost from post-study salary (life-path value signal).
data_notes: Decimal years to recoup total cost; a derived estimate.

definition: Whether any scholarship applies to this course.
Typical or maximum scholarship value.
data_notes: Number amount + ISO currency; typical/max value.

definition: Nature of the scholarship.
data_notes: One value; multiple scholarships may need an array later.

definition: Whether it is applied automatically vs requires a separate application.
Eligibility criteria (GPA, nationality, discipline, etc.).
Average starting salary for graduates, by discipline/country.
data_notes: Number amount + ISO currency; by discipline/country.

definition: Share of graduates employed within ~6 months.
data_notes: Percent; pick one convention (e.g. 87 = 87%) and keep it consistent.

definition: Labour-market demand for the field in the destination country.
Projected employment growth for the linked occupation.

possible_values: e.g. NMBA (nursing), CA ANZ (accounting), Engineers Australia
definition: Body a graduate registers with to legally practise (nursing, teaching, engineering, accounting). Distinct from academic accreditation.
data_notes: Open list; body to register with to practise; null if none.

definition: Share of students who complete an industry placement.
Minimum entry GPA normalised to a single scale so the AI can match against a student's GPA.
data_notes: Decimal on one chosen scale; always pair with min_gpa_scale.

definition: The source grading scale the normalised GPA maps from.
data_notes: One value; the source scale being normalised from.

definition: Minimum English requirement normalised to an IELTS-equivalent scale for matching.
data_notes: Decimal on an IELTS-equivalent scale for matching.

definition: Whether an English-test waiver is offered (conditions in a notes field).
data_notes: Boolean; waiver conditions go in Definition.

definition: Maximum number of academic backlogs accepted.
Minimum years of work experience required (0 if none).
Whether GRE/GMAT/SAT is mandatory vs optional/not required.
Required prior subjects or qualifications.
Minimum age where a course or visa imposes one.
Campus geocode latitude (regional/metro logic, maps, distances).
Campus geocode longitude.
Urban vs regional classification of the campus (country-defined). Powers the 'urban vs regional' recommendation.
Population of the campus city (size / lifestyle signal).
Broad climate of the campus city.
Availability of part-time work for students in the area.
Presence of the student's home community near campus (comfort/support signal).
data_notes: One value; may become per-home-country later.

definition: Distance to the nearest major city (regional context).
City safety index, comparable across locations.
data_notes: Decimal index; keep one consistent source/scale.

definition: Whether a packaged/conditional English course (ELICOS in AU, pre-sessional in UK) is offered before the main course.
Typical length of English study needed to meet entry.
data_notes: Whole number of weeks; usually depends on the score gap.

possible_values: Any text (e.g. Navitas, INTO, in-house centre)
definition: Provider/centre delivering the English pathway.
Whether a conditional offer (pending English/academics) is available.

possible_values: Subclass 500 (AU) / Study Permit (CA) / Student visa (UK) / Fee-Paying Student (NZ) / F-1 (US)
definition: Relevant student visa (AU Subclass 500, CA Study Permit, UK Student visa, NZ Fee-Paying Student, US F-1).
data_notes: One value; effectively set by destination country.

definition: Typical processing time for the destination student visa.
Whether the student visa permits bringing dependents for this course/level.
Permitted work hours during study on the student visa.
data_notes: Whole number; adopt a convention for 'unlimited in breaks'.

definition: Typical time from application submission to offer.
